name: Toudou Taiga
source:
The president of an oil company who dug up oil and became the oil king.
He is open to any opponent and treats them frankly.
He has a diplomat father and has lived abroad with his parents since he was little.
He has a history of being a backpacker.

[From [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/nemurihime/chara/taiga_toudou.html]official website[/url]]
